title: English rung 01: Tenses and verb forms

questions.question: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation: Two past events: the earlier one (the train leaving) takes the past perfect.

questions.question: She ___ in Kanpur since 2020.
questions.explanation: "Since" a point in time with a situation that continues now takes the present perfect.

questions.question: I ___ him yesterday.
questions.explanation: "Yesterday" fixes a finished past time: simple past.

questions.question: Look! It ___.
questions.explanation: "Look!" points to something happening now: present continuous.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C.
questions.explanation: A general truth takes the simple present.

questions.question: He said that he ___ the report the next day.
If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the trip.
questions.explanation: A real future condition: present in the if-clause, "will" in the result.

questions.question: If I had known, I ___ you.
questions.explanation: An unreal past condition: "had known" with "would have + past participle".

questions.question: She ___ for two hours when the guests arrived.
questions.explanation: An action that went on up to a past moment takes the past perfect continuous.

questions.question: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.explanation: A universal truth takes the simple present.

questions.question: I have lived here ___ ten years.
questions.explanation: "For" goes with a length of time; "since" goes with a starting point.

questions.question: He has ___ his lunch.
questions.explanation: The present perfect takes the past participle: has eaten.

questions.question: She ___ the exam last month.
questions.explanation: "Last month" is a finished past time: simple past.

questions.question: I ___ to the library every Saturday.
questions.explanation: A habit takes the simple present.

questions.question: They ___ the project when the manager called.
questions.explanation: An action in progress when another one happened takes the past continuous.
